entries.24fa718b65664984: This business supports CREM (corporate real estate management), through which clients optimize their owned assets. It provides management and operation of owned assets, advice on decisions regarding holding policy, simultaneous consolidation of multi-site facilities, and support for formulating medium- to long-term repair plans. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,022 million.

entries.3906d2c804dce11c: This business supports DX (digital transformation) carried out by customers, drawing on the know-how the company has built up. It provides systems that visualize employee activities, systems that visualize project management information, and systems that digitize ordering processes across multiple sites. It was newly established in April 2021. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥452 million.
entries.3d2c7e7f9f469649: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6,114 million, with the CM Business at ¥3,077 million, the Office Business at ¥1,562 million, the CREM Business at ¥1,022 million and the DX Support Business at ¥452 million.
entries.419daccc0681ff7a: In the fiscal year ended March 2026, as private companies became temporarily more cautious in their construction investment decisions, increased orders for CM services in the public sector supported revenue. CM Business revenue of ¥3,077 million accounted for about half of the total, while Office Business grew to ¥1,562 million, owing to factors including completion of large-scale head office relocation projects.
entries.464f178eb1a40135: CM Business (support for project owners in the construction and operation of various facilities)
entries.47b11874f23ff046: The company operates as a listed company specializing in CM (construction management, i.e., project owner support business).
entries.47c9ef47cf4a3270: Project owners such as private companies and local governments use the service for new construction, renovation and relocation projects for offices, government buildings, schools, factories and medical facilities.
entries.483b84d01b2aa6f4: It provides formulation of basic plans, preparation of tender specifications, tender implementation, support for project owners in selecting contractors, design management and construction management. These services are common to the Office, CM and CREM Businesses; in the DX Support Business, it also supports DX implementation using its in-house developed systems.
entries.495748013b916f78: Public clients, such as local governments, that develop government offices, schools and medical facilities
entries.4be4c15dc08db51b: This business supports the construction and operation of various facilities, including public government buildings, educational facilities, production facilities, medical facilities, railway station facilities, commercial facilities and office buildings, using the CM (construction management) method. From preparing basic plans through tender specifications, conducting tenders, design management and construction management, it supports clients on the client side while making each process visible. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,077 million.

entries.93b513f6da417fae: Project owner support services using the CM method

It also applies know-how developed through its own DX practice, such as its in-house project management system and activity visualization mechanisms, to services for customers.
entries.99a76a8a463ed8da: This business provides project management for office relocation, new construction and renovation. It supports all work related to office creation and operation, including proposing floor area after relocation, building ICT and data centers, supporting work style reform, and reducing space to cut maintenance costs. In principle, the company also carries out office design. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,562 million.

entries.b6508bb75df9d190: The company operates as a listed company specializing in CM (construction management, i.e., project owner support business).
